value.rationale: The natural graph-BV plus sup norm is a finite graph signal regularization Banach structure. Classifying every exposed vertex on arbitrary finite positive weighted graphs and every facet on positive weighted paths yields a complete and weight-robust combinatorial invariant, nontrivial beyond threshold coarea alone; explicit inequalities and a min-cut dual decision reduction make the result reusable for exact norm and optimization questions.
